terms.title: Terms of use
terms.content: By creating an account on monemploiGo, you agree to use the service fairly, provide accurate information, and not attempt to compromise the site's security. Purchased documents are for personal use. Any attempt to hack, intrude on, or fraudulently use the service will result in the account being suspended.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.intro: MonEmploiGo only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work:
items: "monemploigo_session": keeps you securely logged in to your account (30 days);
"NEXT_LOCALE": remembers the language you chose, French or English (1 year).
paragraphs: These cookies are essential: without them, you could not stay logged in. They are not used for advertising or audience measurement.

The site also remembers a few preferences in your browser (local storage), without sending them to MonEmploiGo: that you have read the cookie information banner, the postponed review request ("Later", 30 days), and hiding the information ticker during your visit.
No advertising cookies or audience measurement tools are used.
The fonts (Google Fonts) and the sample photos in the templates (Unsplash) are loaded from these services' servers: your browser sends them your IP address. To learn more, see our Privacy Policy.

editor.qualityEndBeforeStart: {item}: the end date is before the start date.
editor.qualityStartFuture: {item}: the start date is in the future.
editor.qualityEndFuture: {item}: the end date is in the future. If it's still ongoing, tick the box provided.

editor.subject: Subject
editor.bodyHint: No need to add "Kind regards" or your name at the end: the closing and signature are added automatically.
editor.germanPersonalDataHint: A German CV (Lebenslauf) traditionally includes this information, especially for an application sent from abroad. These fields remain optional.
editor.germanLanguageHint: Be specific about your certified German level (e.g. B1, B2, telc B2 Pflege) — it's the single most checked detail for a German Ausbildung/Pflege application.
editor.saveError: Something went wrong while saving. Check your connection and try again.

editor.cvLanguageHint: The CV headings and labels will be in this language, whatever the language of the site. Write your content in the same language.
editor.canadaLocationHint: Example: Douala, Cameroon or Toronto, Ontario. Do not give your full postal address, and only the place where you actually live.
editor.canadaSummaryHint: 2 to 4 lines: your occupation, years of experience, main areas and strengths. Only include accurate information.
editor.canadaSkillsHint: Ideally 6 to 10 concrete skills, separated by commas.
editor.certificationsHint: Optional. Only add certifications you have actually obtained.
editor.loginRequired: Log in to save and pay for your document.
editor.targetRoleHint: The role you're aiming for — useful even if you don't have work experience yet.
editor.noExperienceLabel: I don't have work experience yet
editor.noExperienceHint: No worries: you can still highlight an internship, an academic project, volunteering, or a student activity in this section.
editor.bbSourceOfListing: How did you hear about this opening?
editor.bbMotivationNotesHint: For an even more convincing letter, add specific details from the job posting here (city, concrete tasks, requirements): the more specific the text is to the target company, the more credible it looks to the recruiter. Write these notes in German, in full sentences: they are added to the letter as they are.

items.text: Paid documents: free re-download for 3 weeks, then automatic deletion. Keep a copy of your PDF.
Aim for one page: the editor's indicator tells you live whether your CV fits on one A4 page.
Need a Word file? Open your PDF with Microsoft Word (File > Open) to make it editable.

ats.title: Why choose an ATS resume?
ats.intro: An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is recruitment software: it reads your resume, extracts your information and helps the recruiter sort applications. Many large companies, international organizations and online job platforms use one. A heavily designed resume (several columns, icons, charts) may be read incorrectly.

points.title: Read without errors
points.text: A single column, standard section titles and real text, with no icons or photo: the software finds every piece of information in its place.

points.title: Found through keywords
points.text: The software compares your resume with the job offer. Reuse the exact words from the ad (job title, skills, software) in your profile and experience.

points.title: Liked by recruiters
points.text: Clean and easy to scan, it also makes a good impression when a recruiter reads it, on screen or printed.

ats.whenTitle: Choose it if you are applying:
when: through a job website or an online form
to a large company or a multinational
to an international organization or an NGO

german.title: Why an ATS resume for Germany?
german.intro: In Germany, most applications are sent online: by email or through the employer's application portal. Large employers, including many hospital groups, sort applications with software (ATS). And recruiters expect a "Lebenslauf": a clear, structured, chronological resume.

points.title: Lebenslauf format
points.text: Section titles in German (Berufserfahrung, Ausbildung…) and the usual personal details: date and place of birth, nationality. Everything stays optional.

points.title: Read by screening software
points.text: A clean layout and real text: the recruiter's software reads your resume without errors.

points.title: Your German level stands out
points.text: State your certificate (B1, B2, telc B2 Pflege…): it's the first thing institutions check for an Ausbildung.

points.title: Optional photo
points.text: It is no longer mandatory in Germany but is still common. If you add one, choose a professional photo.

pricing.title: Pricing and payment
pricing.intro: Creating your account, choosing a template and filling in your document are free: you only pay when you download the finished document. Each category has a single price, whatever template you choose.
payment: Payment is made by Mobile Money (MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money), with a Cameroonian Mobile Money account. No bank card is needed.
The payment is processed by our provider Notch Pay: you enter your number directly on its payment page, then confirm on your phone.
monemploiGo will never ask for your Mobile Money PIN code or your password.
after: Your document is unlocked as soon as the payment is confirmed, and you download it as a PDF.
You can download it again for free, as often as you like, for 21 days from your dashboard. It is then deleted automatically: keep a copy of your PDF.
Need a Word version? Open the PDF with Microsoft Word (File > Open) to convert it into an editable document.
problems: If the payment fails, is canceled or expires, your document is not unlocked and monemploiGo charges you nothing: you can simply try again.
If your Mobile Money account was debited but your document is not unlocked, write to us with your account email address, the payment date and the document concerned.
Refund conditions are described in the "Refund policy" section of our Terms of Use.

about.title: About monemploiGo
about.intro: monemploiGo is an online platform that helps job seekers in Cameroon create a professional CV and cover letter, in English or French.
forWho: recent graduates preparing their first CV, even without work experience;
people looking for a job or an internship in Cameroon;
applicants preparing an application in Germany, in particular for an Ausbildung.
features: choose from Standard, Premium, ATS and German (Lebenslauf) CV templates, and cover letter templates;
fill in your details and see your document update live, with an indicator telling you whether it fits on one page;
create a German cover letter (Bewerbungsbrief) for an Ausbildung;
pay with Mobile Money and download your document as a PDF.
about.not: monemploiGo is a document creation tool. It is not a recruitment agency, a temporary employment agency, or an immigration or visa agency. A good CV helps you present your application, but no service can guarantee a job, an interview or an Ausbildung.
commitments: clear prices, shown before any payment;
your data is never sold, and your documents are deleted automatically after 21 days;
no advertising cookies or audience measurement tools.
